saved to My effects: 'ProjectY_Mangnani_ATTACK_south-east_Trail' (effect id 96461e8d-2fdb-46ad-8ecf-2fd0b63253a5); open it to tweak with sliders: https://pixellab.ai/create-vfx?effect=96461e8d-2fdb-46ad-8ecf-2fd0b63253a5
128x128, 8 frames @ 12 fps, plays once; anchor (feet) at 64,97
still warns: frames 1, 2 show no effect at all; check life windows and intensity; trail_6 is drawn behind the sprite and 100% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto). The user gets it as saved: fix it on step d8dc9ad2-5c39-479f-b72f-26502706bce7 and export again with --replace 96461e8d-2fdb-46ad-8ecf-2fd0b63253a5, or say why it is right as it is.
download https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp/pixel-tools/81ab62db-f135-4375-b429-9f3a5c6e78ab/: projecty-mangnani-attack-south-east-trail-game.zip, projecty-mangnani-attack-south-east-trail.gif, projecty-mangnani-attack-south-east-trail.json, projecty-mangnani-attack-south-east-trail.png
the game pack: one sheet per piece (the whole effect, behind and in front of the sprite, each part) + manifest.json (what each clip is and where it goes: anchor + offset) + README.txt
image id: 81ab62db-f135-4375-b429-9f3a5c6e78ab (its frames, image 1; for pixelart_workbench inspect/edit or save_to_asset)
